passages.text: {{About|the tree|other uses of Crescentia|Crescentia (disambiguation)|the vine and its fruit|calabash|other uses of calabash|Calabash (disambiguation)}}

Crescentia (calabash tree, huingo, krabasi, or kalebas) is a genus of six species of flowering plants in the family Bignoniaceae, native to Mexico, the Caribbean, Central America, and northern South America. The species are moderate-size trees growing to {{convert|10|m|ft|round=5|abbr=on}} tall, and producing large spherical fruits, with a thin, hard shell and soft pulp, up to {{convert|25|cm|in|0|abbr=on}} in diameter.

Uses
The hard shell can be used for containers, scoops, cups etc.
